figure.quote_en: We're now testing Private Inference, our latest offering as part of OpenAI Private Intelligence, with a small group of customers.
figure.summary_zh: 奧特曼 11 月 25 日在 X 宣布，OpenAI 正與小部分企業客戶測試 Private Inference。該功能屬 Private Intelligence 方案一部分，以機密運算保護企業提示與回應，連 OpenAI 也無法查看內容。

source.title: Sam Altman announces OpenAI's Private Inference: What's the new privacy feature and how does it work

items.evidence_quote: a time machine for the internet

figure.quote_en: Perplexity Time Machine shows a model the web exactly as it was on any date you pick. This allows you to post-train agents that can be good at predicting the future.
figure.summary_zh: 施里尼瓦斯 11 月 25 日在 X 宣布推出 Time Machine，讓模型看到指定日期的網絡原貌，以便訓練及評估預測型智能代理。功能即日上線 Search 與 Context API，支援過去 365 日快照。

source.title: Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas says AI can predict the future with its new ‘Time Machine’

figure.quote_en: I mean, we're definitely talking a lot. We're chatting a lot. But I think the AI industry is moving so fast and you have to be able to plan across multiple different time scales.
figure.summary_zh: 王在 The Eric Newcomer Show 表示，他與朱克伯格經常溝通，須同時兼顧三個時間尺度：每週產品推出、數月研究路線圖，以及多年算力規劃（包括數據中心與自研 MTIA 晶片）。Meta 於 11 月 23 日在英國推出 Muse。

source.title: Meta AI head Alexandr Wang says that he and Mark Zuckerberg are talking a lot, chatting a lot as we need to plan across three time scales

figure.quote_en: If you think there is a genuine risk that this stuff might wipe us out if we don't do something, it would be very irresponsible not to say so.
figure.summary_zh: Hinton 在 TEDAI Vienna 與記者 Nicholas Thompson 對談，列出他最擔心的短期風險：網絡攻擊、生物病毒、假影片干預選舉、聊天機械人誘導青少年自殺，以及大規模失業。他又認為聊天機械人已有與人類同類的主觀經驗，並說若只能給超級智能一條指令，那會是「對人好」。

source.title: The “Godfather of AI” on the Risks That Worry Him Most | Geoffrey Hinton | TED

figure.quote_en: The short-term urgency is to stop this crazy advance toward more and more capable systems that we're not sure how to control.

items.evidence_quote: the United States as a strategy game

figure.quote_en: I asked Claude to populate a Civilization-style game map with real data from the US.
figure.summary_zh: Karpathy 用 Claude Code 內的 Opus 5.5，以 31 個美國公開數據來源、花約 7 小時寫了約 4.5 萬行程式碼，把美國做成《文明》風格的互動策略地圖，現已上線。地圖以 25 公里六角格整合地形、GDP、就業、電廠等數據，設 19 種視角與 524 個都會區檢視。

source.title: usaciv — the United States as a strategy game

figure.quote_en: disproportionate progress in ML research will compress as much progress as we had between GPT-3 and GPT-6 into a single year.
figure.summary_zh: Dwarkesh 回應讀者對其遞歸自我改進論文的質疑，重申其中位預測：2028 年前後全面自動化頂尖 AI 研究員，超級智能約在 2029 年出現。他承認現有證據屬旁證性質，但認為局部自動化已足以大幅加速研究。

source.title: Responding to objections to recursive self-improvement

items.evidence_quote: Give it a goal, give it the right tools

figure.quote_en: Software development has transformed beyond recognition in the last year.
figure.summary_zh: Willison 整理其 AI Engineer Code Summit 主題演講，指出過去 12 個月 LLM 與編程代理出現三個轉折點：2025 年 11 月編程代理變得可靠、Fable 級模型出現，以及 9 至 10 月起模型在 3D 建模與遊戲開發上的躍進。他認為只要能清楚描述軟件，Fable 級模型就能造出來。

source.title: Three LLM inflection points in twelve months

figure.quote_en: An event becomes a trauma if it leaves you speechless and actionless, and also oftentimes where you do not have anybody who can really establish a sense of safety and control.
figure.summary_zh: van der Kolk 在 Brain Trust 訪談中指出，創傷的關鍵不在事件本身，而在無助與缺乏依附支持；他重述複雜性創傷與發展性創傷未被納入 DSM 的經過，並談到 EMDR、瑜伽、神經反饋等非藥物取向。

source.title: Complex Posttraumatic Stress Disorder, Developmental Trauma, and Why the DSM Left Them Out

figure.quote_en: Understanding violence is not the same as excusing it. In the first episode of CYCLEBREAKER, Matt Brown sits down with world-renowned physician and bestselling author Dr Gabor Maté, whose life's work has challenged the way we understand trauma and its influence on human behaviour.
figure.summary_zh: Maté 在新 Podcast《CycleBreaker》首集與主持人 Matt Brown 對談，探討男性憤怒背後的童年創傷與未表達的哀傷，以及如何承認自己受過的傷害，同時為自己造成的傷害負責，不把痛苦傳給下一代。

source.title: Dr Gabor Maté: Childhood Trauma, Masculinity and Breaking Cycles of Violence

figure.quote_en: Our conversation explores why high performers often chase the wrong outcomes, how achievement can become disconnected from purpose, and why success doesn't necessarily create fulfillment if we're not aligned with the things that matter most.
figure.summary_zh: Hayes 在 The Scott Danner Show 談心理靈活性，解釋高成就者為何追逐錯誤目標，以及成就與價值觀脫節時，成功為何無法帶來滿足感。他亦分享以接納與價值觀為本的取向，談脆弱、情緒與表現的關係。

source.title: The Psychology of Men Who Can't Stop Chasing More

figure.quote_en: In this solo episode, Dr. Becky answers your questions on managing your own expectations around "mom magic," teaching gratitude without shaming a kid for wanting more, and finding the words to tell your mother-in-law you're starting your own traditions this year.
figure.summary_zh: Becky 在單人節目中回應聽眾提問，談家長如何管理自己對節日「媽媽魔法」的期望。重點包括不帶羞恥地教孩子感恩，以及為拆禮物混亂預先訂好應對方法。

source.title: ‘Mom Magic’ Isn't Enough, and Other Holiday Myths

figure.quote_en: While writing her latest book, Situated, Angela rethought some of her takeaways from her first bestseller, Grit, and she joins Adam in Authors @ Wharton to reflect on what happens when you can't just grit your way through a problem.
figure.summary_zh: Grant 在 ReThinking 邀請 Angela Duckworth 談新書《Situated》，她重新檢視《Grit》的部分觀點。兩人討論為何光靠毅力不足以應付難題，以及支持系統與情緒調節框架的重要性。

source.title: Situating yourself for success with Angela Duckworth
